about_the_game:
Goodbye Cards is a casual card game where you'll earn the judge's approval through clever card combinations. You and other players will strategically play your cards in each round, and the judge will evaluate each player's move based on factors like logical coherence, creative flair, and more.

In each round, you and other players will select cards to play your moves. The AI will evaluate each play based on logic, creativity, and other factors, scoring each player accordingly.

Successfully playing a card triggers your ability.

Top-ranked players can win special cards and use them to exchange for rewards.

  • The Judge

  • We've integrated advanced natural language and image understanding models, enabling the judge to truly "comprehend" the meaning behind every card combination you play. This moves beyond rigid rules, injecting unpredictability and immense fun into every match.

  • Turn-Based Play + Instant Scoring

  • Each game is played over multiple rounds. After each turn, the AI instantly evaluates and scores the played cards. The highest-scoring player wins that round’s points, and those with the highest total score at the end receive reward cards! 

  • Card Reward System

  • Top players can unlock powerful or quirky new cards to expand their personal card gallery and gain an edge in future matches.

Who is this game for?

• Fans of creative deduction games like Who’s the Spy, Draw Something, or Word Mahjong
• Strategy card game lovers who enjoy building decks and outsmarting opponents
• Innovative players who enjoy interaction and trying new gameplay.
• You who want to "outwit and outmaneuver the judge."

Why Choose Us?

Our vision extends beyond a mere "casual card game." We've woven the judge deeply into the gameplay, transforming it into a discerning critic, a formidable challenger, a clever puzzle-solver, and even your card-playing companion. It's a dynamic contest between you and the judge, and a vibrant carnival of card creativity.

Join now and let the judge applaud your "stroke of genius" plays!
